description: The official CLI suite for WeChat Work covers business functions such as messaging, email, documents, to-do lists, calendars, meetings, WeChat Drive, and contacts. It supports features such as proactive notifications from chatbots, creating and retrieving documents, document search, creating and managing calendars, scheduling and retrieving meeting information, creating and following up on to-do lists, uploading and retrieving WeChat Drive files, and reading and sending emails.

display.description_zh: 企业微信官方 CLI 套件，覆盖消息、邮件、文档、待办、日程、会议、微盘、通讯录等业务功能。支持机器人主动通知、新建与读取文档、文档搜索、新建管理日程、预约与获取会议信息、新建跟进待办、上传与获取微盘文件、邮件读取与发送等能力
examples_en: Please compile the latest weekly AI news for me and send it to myself via WeChat Work message
Based on my recent WeChat emails and meetings with clients, I have generated a presentation for them
